VERSION_B writes at buf[e - 1]; since e can equal buflen (loop condition e < buflen allows e to reach buflen after increment), e - 1 = buflen - 1 is still in range, but if e == 0 (e.g. half == 0 so the first loop never runs, and the truncation path is taken), buf[e - 1] = buf[-1] is an out-of-bounds write before the buffer. This is a buffer underflow write in VERSION_B not present in VERSION_A.
